I have been growing rice on this small piece of land since I was a young girl, and my mother taught me to use cow manure to keep the soil good. I cannot buy chemical fertilizer because one bag costs too much money for my small plot, and I do not have cash to spare after buying salt and soap for the house. I will use the rice seed I kept from last year’s harvest, and my grandchildren will help me pull weeds by hand when the time comes. I do not pay workers because I have no extra money for that, so my family will do everything ourselves.
